# emulate full check and also search for lengths that go to strcmp branch
Kmul=0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F1
Kadd=0x5A5A5A5A5A5A5A5A
Kcmp=0x0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0E
C1=0xF4243

def branch_to_strcmp(n):
    # rdx = n*0xf4243
    rdx = (n * C1) & 0xffffffffffffffff
    rdx = (rdx + 7) & 0xffffffffffffffff
    rdx = (rdx * rdx) & 0xffffffffffffffff
    rdx = (rdx * Kmul) & 0xffffffffffffffff
    rdx = (rdx + Kadd) & 0xffffffffffffffff
    # cmp rax=Kcmp, rdx; jae taken if Kcmp >= rdx
    return Kcmp >= rdx, rdx

# test some n
for n in [0,1,2,3,10,25,26,100,1000,10000]:
    b,rdx = branch_to_strcmp(n)
    print(n, b, hex(rdx))
